title: One More Morning in the Dolomites
route: Selva di Val Gardena → Lago di Carezza → Brescia
introTitle: A peaceful farewell to the Dolomites.
intro: Enjoy breakfast at Hotel Granbaita before checking out around 10 AM. Drive to Lago di Carezza for mountain-and-lake views, photographs and a relaxed lunch. Take the main-road approach and check weather and road conditions before setting off. After the lake, continue to Brescia for a late-afternoon hotel check-in. No additional mountain-village detours are planned.

stops.name: Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Breakfast at Hotel Granbaita, then check out and depart around 10 AM.

stops.name: Lago di Carezza
stops.description: Enjoy the lake and surrounding mountain scenery, take photos and stop for lunch. Use designated parking and check road conditions before departure.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Return to Brescia and check into the Hilton in the late afternoon.
